pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

comment.comment:
$ORBIO | The Price Is Down. The Infrastructure Is Growing. And Holders Are Increasing. 🪐

Another update on https://x.com/orbiodotso

While the token continues consolidating around a $23M market cap, the underlying metrics tell a more interesting story.

October 30 → November 1:
• AI tokens processed: 157.3B → 196.7B (+25%)
• Protocol fees collected: $468.1K → $473K
• API usage: $65.4K → $69K
• Agents launched: 2,179 → 2,215
• Creator fees harvested: 7.49M → 7.84M ORBIO

And here's another metric worth watching.

15,607 $ORBIO holders.

According to HolderScan:
• +52 holders in 24 hours
• +88 in 3 days
• +200 in 7 days (+1.30%)

Among the five tokens I'm tracking, ORBIO is the only one with positive seven-day holder growth.

Wallet growth doesn't necessarily mean unique new investors or whale accumulation. But seeing the holder base expand during a deep price correction is encouraging.

Now, here's what excites me most.

Orbio recently highlighted Kivo, an autonomous trading agent using its infrastructure.

According to the team, Kivo used AI tools to research the market, execute a trading decision, and pay for inference through CREDIT funded by its own fees.

Imagine this model operating at scale.

Agents generating economic activity, paying for their own intelligence, and continuing to operate with less human intervention.

Orbio wouldn't need every agent to succeed. It could become the intelligence infrastructure supporting an entire autonomous economy.

But the economics still need proof.

AI token throughput isn't cash revenue. CREDIT activations aren't necessarily new paying customers. And increasing wallet counts don't automatically create token demand.

What I want to see next is clear:
Recurring paid inference, measurable usage from external integrations, sustainable fees, and stronger value capture for $ORBIO.

I'm still holding and recently added during the correction.

The price is struggling. The technology is advancing. The holder base is expanding.

If real demand follows, this could become a very interesting long-term story.

The billion-dollar vision remains ambitious.

The next step is proving the economics. 🪐

Data: Orbio Analytics, Launchpad Analytics and HolderScan, November 1, 2026.
